You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(g):
    bg=g[0][0]
    # find marker lines: full rows/cols of one color (not bg)
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    hmark=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if len(set(r))==1 and r[0]!=bg]
    vmark=[j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]==g[0][j] and g[0][j]!=bg for i in range(H))]
    oc=set(v for r in g for v in r if v!=bg and v not in (g[0][0] if False else 0))
    ocol=[v for r in g for v in r if v not in (bg,) and all(True)][0]
    # object cells
    obj=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bg and g[i][j]!=2]
    ocol=g[obj[0][0]][obj[0][1]]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    if hmark:
        mr=hmark[0]
        orient='h'
        # direction: object on which side of marker?
        obs=[i for i,j in obj if i<mr]
        bts=[i for i,j in obj if i>mr]
        if obs: dir_=-1; top=min(i for i,_ in obj); bot=max(i for i,_ in obj)
        else: dir_=1; top=min(i for i,_ in obj); bot=max(i for i,_ in obj)
        # push object toward marker until adjacent
        gap = (mr-top-1) if dir_==-1 else (bot-mr-1)
        shift = gap - 1  # leave 1-cell gap? demo2 left 1 gap... verify per case later
        # simpler: move object until adjacent (gap=0), then 8 on far side adjacent
        while True:
            if dir_==-1:
                if top==mr-1: break
                top-=1
                for i,j in [(a,b) for a,b in obj]: pass
            else:
                if bot==mr+1: break
                top+=1
        # place 8 line on far side adjacent to object extreme
        if dir_==-1:
            row=top-1
        else:
            row=bot+1
        for j in range(W): out[row][j]=8
    if vmark:
        mc=vmark[0]
        obs=[j for i,j in obj if j<mc]
        rights=[j for i,j in obj if j>mc]
        if obs: dir_=-1; lc=min(j for _,j in obj); rc=max(j for _,j in obj)
        else: dir_=1; lc=min(j for _,j in obj); rc=max(j for _,j in obj)
        # push until adjacent
        while True:
            if dir_==-1:
                if lc==mc-1: break
                lc-=1
            else:
                if rc==mc+1: break
                lc+=1
        col = lc-1 if dir_==-1 else rc+1
        for i in range(H): out[i][col]=8
    return out

    print(k, f(di)==do_)

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    bg=g[0][0]
    hmark=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if len(set(r))==1 and r[0]!=bg]
    vmark=[j for j in range(W) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(H)})==1 and g[0][j]!=bg]
    obj=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bg and g[i][j]!=2]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    if hmark:
        mr=hmark[0]
        top=min(i for i,_ in obj); bot=max(i for i,_ in obj)
        if top<mr:
            while top!=mr-1: top-=1
            row=top-1
        else:
            while bot!=mr+1: bot+=1
            row=bot+1
        for j in range(W): out[row][j]=8
    if vmark:
        mc=vmark[0]
        lc=min(j for _,j in obj); rc=max(j for _,j in obj)
        if lc<mc:
            while lc!=mc-1: lc-=1
            col=lc-1
        else:
            while rc!=mc+1: rc+=1
            col=rc+1
        for i in range(H): out[i][col]=8
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])

    oc=[c for c in set(x for r in g for x in r) if c not in (bg,2)]

    o=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==oc]

    vertical = len({i for i,_ in two})==1 or len({j for _,j in two})==1 and len(two)>W//2
    # determine orientation: line is the long straight run; find it by checking rows/cols counts
    rows={}
    for i,j in two: rows.setdefault(i,[]).append(j)
    cols={}
    for i,j in two: cols.setdefault(j,[]).append(i)
    vert = max(len(v) for v in cols.values())>=max(len(v) for v in rows.values())
    out=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i,j in two: out[i][j]=2
    if vert:
        # line vertical at col c
        cj=cols[list(cols)[0]][0]
        minj=min(j for _,j in o); maxj=max(j for _,j in o)
        step = 1 if maxj<cj-1 else -1
        new=[(i, cj-step if step==-1 else cj+1) for i,j in o]
        for i,j in new: out[i][j]=oc
        lo=min(j for _,j in new)-step if step==1 else max(j for _,j in new)+step
        for i in range(H): out[i][lo]=8
    else:
        ci=rows[list(rows)[0]][0]
        mini=min(i for i,_ in o); maxi=max(i for i,_ in o)
        step = 1 if maxi<ci-1 else -1
        new=[(ci-step if step==-1 else ci+1, j) for i,j in o]
        for i,j in new: out[i][j]=oc
        lo = min(i for i,_ in new)-step if step==1 else max(i for i,_ in new)+step
        for j in range(W): out[lo][j]=8

import os,re
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
# find the last occurrence of Test input section
m=re.search(r'Test input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t)
h,w=int(m.group(1)),int(m.group(2))
rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
ti=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
H,W=len(ti),len(ti[0])
two=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if ti[i][j]==2]
seven=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if ti[i][j]==7]
print('2 cols:', sorted({j for _,j in two}))
print('7 rows/cols:', sorted({i for i,_ in seven}), sorted({j for _,j in seven}))
for r in ti: print(''.join(map(str,r)))
